purpose: Establish the center, membership, class-mode, and assignment facts consumed by scheduling and scoped product views.
success_outcome: An authorized admin can manage center-bounded participants, links, explicit individual/group classes, and assignment authorization facts; unauthorized and cross-center operations are rejected.
anti_goals: Do not duplicate Identity & Access account ownership.
Do not infer class authorization from a route or client payload.
Do not compose Lesson Context, Collaboration, or Learning Progress views in the provider boundary.
constraints: Center & Scheduling owns membership, class, parent-link, and assignment state.
All protected operations resolve actor and resource scope on the server.
invariants: Every membership and class relationship is center-bounded.
Class mode is exactly individual or group.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-001: admin CRUD smoke with center, participant, link, and individual/group class assertions plus cross-center and unauthorized negatives.
FT-002-AC-002: individual and group relationship matrix with the provider boundary's member-scoped authorization decision and non-member denial.

stop_conditions: Stop if a consumer would need direct membership-table access.
